pairs.instruction: Solve this B.Tech Civil Engineering problem with correct formulas.
pairs.input: A steel bar carries axial load P = 100000 N on area A = 500 mm2. Find axial stress.
pairs.output:

σ = 100000/500 = 200 N/mm².
Final answer: 200 N/mm².
